newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Indonesian formin to arrive in Brazil for talks.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian formin to arrive in Brazil for talks.

text.p: Indonesian Foreign Affairs Minister Ali Alatas was due to arrive in Brasilia on Tuesday for talks with Brazilian officials on bilateral political ties and international issues, a Foreign Ministry spokesman said.

On the first visit to Brazil by an Indonesian foreign minister since diplomatic relations were established in 1953, Alatas was scheduled to meet Foreign Minister Luiz Felipe Lampreia and President Fernando Henrique Cardoso on Wednesday.

The Foreign Ministry spokesman said talks were expected to focus on political ties between Latin America and the Asia-Pacific region, as well as the agenda for the first ministerial meeting of the World Trade Organization in December.
The former Portuguese colony of East Timor, invaded by Indonesia in 1975 and annexed a year later, would also be on the agenda, he said.

Alatas, who was arriving from Chile and was due to fly on to New York on Friday, was expected to concentrate on political dialogue, leaving trade issues to Industries and Trade Minister Tungky Ariwibowo, who will visit Brazil next week.
